header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH AT KARACHI
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE(S) OF JUDGE(S)
Mr.Imdad Ali Sahito, Advocate for the Petitioner.
Mr.Sardar Zafar Hussain, Advocate for the Department. .
body: ---- Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Petitioner has made an application for renewal of Customs Agents License and has subsequently also applied to the competent authority within the Department to be allowed to sit in forthcoming licensing test in terms of Rule 93 of the Customs Rules, 2001. Learned counsel for the Department has placed on record a Hearing Notice dated 29.10.2026 on the subject of the earlier application and submits that if the Petitioner or his authorized representative appears on the said date, a proper hearing would be conducted and a speaking order would be made on the subject. Further he states that the subsequent application made by the Petitioner for sitting in the test would also be considered within the framework of the relevant Rules and order would be made.
Let the needful be done without undue delay. Petition stands disposed of in such terms along with listed applications.
